findings.defect: The original filter ends at the method name or (), while the matching Swift Testing runtime filters the complete Test.ID.description including its source-location suffix.

proofChain.fact: The regex predicate uses String(describing: item.test.id); matched concrete test IDs determine graph selection.
The macro forwards the complete function name and AttributeInfo arguments to Test.__function.
The Test attribute name supplies sourceBounds and those bounds are included in function arguments.
Macro source locations are emitted from the actual file ID/path, line and column.
The function test stores its name, containing type and source bounds.
A test sourceLocation is its stored sourceBounds.lowerBound.
Non-suite test IDs retain their source location; description appends it as another slash component.
A SwiftPM entry with a filter and empty selected tests suppresses console output and returns EXIT_NO_TESTS_FOUND.
Linux EXIT_NO_TESTS_FOUND is EX_UNAVAILABLE; the Never overload exits with the result.

findings.meaning: This controller filter deterministically excludes both normally generated requested test IDs. The silent69 result is exactly the matching implementation no-selected-tests path; it is not a per-test assertion failure or evidence of conditional Testing omission.
findings.selectionBoundary: Anchored module + suite + exactly two complete parameterless method names + mandatory exact source basename and positive line/column. It does not select the suite parent or any other27 method.
findings.notClaimed: No test IDs were enumerated or test bodies executed during this diagnosis. Runtime discovery/product integrity beyond retained qualification is not newly observed.
